description: This file contains utility functions and constants for managing graph structures, flow building, variable handling, and session memory in a flow-based application. It imports various external modules and project-specific entities, and defines functions for constructing graphs, managing flow nodes, clearing session memories, and handling variables.

methods.name: getUserHome
methods.description: Returns the home directory path of the current user, falling back to the current working directory if not found.

methods.name: getNodeModulesPackagePath
methods.description: Searches for the specified package in various node_modules directories relative to __dirname and returns the path if found.

methods.name: constructGraphs
methods.description: Builds a directed graph and node dependency scores from flow nodes and edges, with options for reversed or non-directed graphs.

methods.name: getStartingNode
methods.description: Identifies nodes with zero dependencies as starting points in the graph.

methods.name: getStartingNodes
methods.description: Calculates starting nodes based on the graph and an end node, using depth analysis.

methods.name: getAllConnectedNodes
methods.description: Performs a BFS to find all nodes connected to a start node in the graph.

methods.name: getEndingNodes
methods.description: Finds terminal nodes in the graph, verifying their categories and outputs.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Extracts filename(s) from a base64 string or storage URI.

methods.name: saveUpsertFlowData
methods.description: Stores flow node data into an upsert history object, including handling file inputs.

methods.name: checkIfDocLoaderShouldBeIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a document loader node should be skipped based on its connection to a vector store.

methods.name: buildFlow
methods.description: Constructs and executes a flow from start nodes, managing node initialization, variable resolution, and routing.

methods.name: clearSessionMemory
methods.description: Clears chat memories for nodes of category 'Memory' or type 'OpenAIAssistant', based on session or chat ID.

methods.name: getGlobalVariable
methods.description: Retrieves global variables, overriding with static values if specified.

methods.name: getVariableValue
methods.description: Extracts variable values from output responses, handling nested variable syntax and escape characters.
